findings.title: Thrown storage failures erase the progress needed to restart
findings.problem: The exception handlers replace the queue or bank result with zeroed counters. The new continuation decision then computes progress from those replacement counters, losing successful work completed before the exception. Returned failures preserve progress, but thrown failures do not.
findings.failure_scenario: The bank successfully voices several passages, then uploading prewarm/cursor.json fails. prewarmBank throws, runJob replaces its result with voiced: 0 and failed: 0, and an otherwise empty queue leaves progress=false and more=false. The workflow therefore does not perform the promised delayed continuation after this storage blip.
findings.fix: Preserve partial results when an operation throws, either by returning structured failures from the workers or by tracking completed work outside their exception boundaries. Add a test that fails a cursor upload after a successful synthesis and asserts failed=true, progress=true, and more=true.

findings.title: Cached passages bypass the run's time limit
findings.problem: The deadline check comes after both the decided-record and queued-work continue paths. Consequently, scanning cached passages is unbounded by until, including after the deadline has already passed.
findings.failure_scenario: CHECK_VERSION 4 restarts a scan over a large, mostly voiced bank. Every cached passage performs a storage download and continues without checking the deadline. With thousands of passages and slow storage, that scan can consume the remaining workflow runtime and hit the 45-minute cancellation before the worker writes GITHUB_OUTPUT, defeating the time reserved for continuation.
findings.fix: Check the deadline before processing each passage, including cached and queued passages, and at bank-pagination boundaries. Stop with a saved resumable cursor when time expires. Add a test where cached-record reads advance the clock past until and verify that the scan stops promptly rather than traversing the remaining bank.

assessment: Two major operational defects remain in the new failure-continuation and runtime-budget behavior. The added normalization rules did not reveal a concrete clinical accuracy defect in the supplied code. Tests were reviewed statically, not executed.
